csv_project_name: DB for MARS PPF Decontamination Shower Facility
csv_scope_of_work: Virginia Commercial Space Flight Authority ( VCSFA or Virginia Spaceport Authority or VSA ) is requesting proposals for the design and construction of a dedicated 160 square foot decontamination room to support personnel and/or equipment decontamination operations in a controlled environment at the Mid Atlantic Regional Spaceport (MARS) Payload Processing Facility (PPF). The decontamination room will serve as an ante room prior to fueling operations and a space to perform decontamination operations post fueling operations.
